item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: Claude百万上下文、OpenAI成人模式与GLM-5-Turbo等重大更新
item.description:
标签: #大模型 #OpenAI #Claude

摘要: 文章介绍了AI领域的多项最新进展：OpenAI计划推出"成人模式"引发内部争议与延迟，Claude正式向用户开放100万token超长上下文窗口，Google推出AI驱动的3D设计工具Stitch，同时智谱发布GLM-5-Turbo，展现了大模型在长文本处理、内容策略和多模态应用方面的持续突破。

原标题: Claude 1M Context 🧠, OpenAI adult mode 🤖, GLM-5-Turbo ⚡

TLDR AI 2026-03-16

Claude 1M Context 🧠, OpenAI adult mode 🤖, GLM-5-Turbo ⚡

OpenAI's Bid to Allow X-Rated Talk Is Freaking Out Its Own Advisers (11 minute read)

OpenAI 计划取消对 X-rated content（色情内容）的禁令，引发了关于潜在风险的激烈内部辩论。尽管拥有心理学和认知神经科学背景的理事会成员对此表示担忧，该公司仍在推进其成人内容计划。OpenAI 工作人员已识别出多项风险，包括潜在的强迫性使用和对聊天机器人的情感过度依赖。该公司已制定计划，监测成人模式（adult mode）可能带来的各种长期影响。由于 OpenAI 目前正优先考虑其他产品，成人模式的发布已被推迟。

OpenAI's plan to drop its ban on X-rated content sparked vigorous internal debate over the potential risks. The company is forging ahead with its erotica plans despite concerns from council members with backgrounds in fields like psychology and cognitive neuroscience. OpenAI staff have identified several risks, including the potential for compulsive use and emotional overreliance on the chatbot. The company has developed a plan to monitor for a range of potential long-term effects of adult mode. Adult mode's release has been delayed as OpenAI is currently prioritizing other products.

OpenAI 计划取消对 X-rated content（色情内容）的禁令，引发了关于潜在风险的激烈内部辩论。尽管拥有心理学和认知神经科学背景的 council members（理事会成员）对此表示担忧，该公司仍在推进其成人内容计划。OpenAI 工作人员已识别出多项风险，包括潜在的强迫性使用和对聊天机器人的情感过度依赖。该公司已制定计划，监测 adult mode（成人模式）可能带来的各种长期影响。由于 OpenAI 目前正优先考虑其他产品，成人模式的发布已被推迟。

Early look at upcoming design tool from Google (2 minute read)

Google 即将推出的设计工具抢先预览（2 分钟阅读）

Google's rebranded design tool, Stitch, will transform into a 3D workspace with AI-powered collaborations, replacing the flat canvas design. Enhancements include voice controls, a conversational agent, and the ability to generate functional React applications from designs. These advancements position Stitch as a comprehensive tool from concept to production, likely featuring at Google I/O 2026.

Google（谷歌）重新品牌化的设计工具 Stitch 将转变为支持 AI 协作的 3D 工作空间，取代传统的平面设计画布。功能增强包括语音控制、对话式智能体，以及从设计生成功能性 React 应用的能力。这些进步使 Stitch 成为从概念到生产的综合工具，很可能在 Google I/O 2026 上亮相。

1M context is now generally available for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 (5 minute read)

Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 正式开放 100 万上下文窗口（5 分钟阅读）

Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 now include the full 1M context window (100万上下文窗口) at standard pricing on the Claude Platform. This means fewer compactions and more of the conversation kept intact. 1M context is now included in Claude Code for Max, Team, and Enterprise users with Opus 4.6. Standard pricing applies across the full window, and there is no multiplier.

Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 现已在 Claude 平台上以标准价格提供完整的 1M context window（100万上下文窗口）。这意味着更少的压缩（compactions）和更完整的对话保留。对于使用 Opus 4.6 的 Max、Team 和 Enterprise 用户，Claude Code 现已包含 100 万上下文。整个窗口范围均适用标准定价，没有倍数加成。

MCP is Dead; Long Live MCP! (20 minute read)

MCP 已死；MCP 万岁！（20 分钟阅读）

The current industry zeitgeist is dialed in on CLIs, just like it was on MCP a few short months ago. Using CLI can result in token savings, but custom CLIs run into the same context problems as MCP, except without structure and many other sacrifices. Individual usage of coding agents looks very different from organizational adoption of coding agents. MCP is the present and future for enterprise and org-level use cases.

当前行业风潮聚焦于 CLIs（命令行界面），就像短短几个月前追捧 MCP（模型上下文协议）一样。使用 CLI 可以节省 token，但自定义 CLI 会遇到与 MCP 相同的上下文问题，且缺乏结构并需要做出许多其他牺牲。个人使用 coding agents（编程智能体）与组织层面采用编程智能体的情况看起来非常不同。MCP 是企业级和组织级用例的现在和未来。

Can LLMs Be Computers? (20 minute read)

LLM 能成为计算机吗？（20 分钟阅读）

Transformers can execute programs efficiently inside their own inference loop. This opens a path towards AI systems that integrate learned representations with compiled algorithms inside a single computational substrate. Solving humanity's toughest problems will require systems that can both reason flexibly and compute reliably. Future AI systems will have software as part of the model.

Transformers（ Transformer 模型）能够在自身的推理循环中高效执行程序。这为 AI systems（AI 系统）开辟了一条道路，使其能够在单一计算底层架构中整合学习表示与编译算法。解决人类最棘手的问题需要既能灵活推理又能可靠计算的系统。未来的 AI 系统将把软件作为模型的一部分。

The Five Categories of World Models (5 minute read)

世界模型的五个类别（5 分钟阅读）

AMI Labs and World Labs both raised over $1B on "world models," but the term covers five distinct approaches: JEPA, spatial intelligence, learned simulation, physical AI infrastructure, and active inference. The sharpest result in the piece is V-JEPA 2, achieving zero-shot robot planning after training on just 62 hours of domain-specific data. Each approach solves a different subproblem, and the lines between them are expected to blur fast.

AMI Labs 和 World Labs 都基于"world models（世界模型）"筹集了超过 10 亿美元，但这一术语涵盖了五种不同的方法：JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）、空间智能、学习模拟、物理 AI 基础设施和主动推断。其中最突出的成果是 V-JEPA 2，仅在 62 小时的特定领域数据训练后就实现了零样本机器人规划。每种方法解决不同的子问题，它们之间的界限预计会迅速模糊。

👨‍💻

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

工程与研究

Replay: The conference where devs actually build durable AI systems (Sponsor)

Replay：开发者真正构建持久 AI 系统的会议（赞助商）

Replay is Temporal's practical conference for devs building real systems. Join for hands-on workshops and leave with prod-ready AI agents.

Replay 是 Temporal 为构建真实系统的开发者举办的实用会议。参加实践研讨会，带走可用于生产的 AI agents（AI 智能体）。

Introducing Attention Residuals: Rethinking depth-wise aggregation (2 minute read)

引入注意力残差：重新思考深度聚合（2 分钟阅读）

Residual connections have long relied on fixed uniform accumulation. Attention Residuals replace standard depth-wise recurrence with learned, input-dependent attention over preceding layers. It enables networks to selectively retrieve past representations, naturally mitigating dilution and hidden-state growth. Attention Residuals have been validated on the Kimi Linear architecture, demonstrating consistent downstream performance gains.

残差连接长期依赖固定的均匀累积。Attention Residuals（注意力残差）用对前层的学习型、输入依赖注意力取代了标准的深度递归。它使网络能够选择性检索过去的表示，自然缓解稀释和隐藏状态增长问题。注意力残差已在 Kimi Linear 架构上得到验证，显示出持续的下游性能提升。

GLM-5-Turbo (1 minute read)

GLM-5-Turbo（1 分钟阅读）

Z.ai's GLM-5-Turbo offers a streamlined API for generating text responses, catering to tasks like crafting marketing slogans. Key features include customizable roles, real-time streaming, and adjustable creativity through the "temperature" setting.

Z.ai 的 GLM-5-Turbo 提供精简的 API 用于生成文本响应，适用于撰写营销标语等任务。主要功能包括可自定义角色、实时流式传输，以及通过 "temperature"（温度）设置调整创造性。

Faster Sparse Attention with IndexCache (GitHub Repo)

使用 IndexCache 加速稀疏注意力（GitHub 仓库）

IndexCache reduces the cost of DeepSeek Sparse Attention by reusing top-k token indices across layers instead of recomputing them every time. The approach removes most indexer computations while maintaining model quality.

IndexCache 通过跨层重用 top-k token 索引而非每次重新计算，降低了 DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DeepSeek 稀疏注意力）的成本。该方法在保持模型质量的同时去除了大部分索引器计算。

Test-Time Training (GitHub Repo)

测试时训练（GitHub 仓库）

Spatial-TTT is a framework that updates a spatial state from streaming visual inputs using test-time training, enabling models to reason over video-based spatial tasks. The method processes visual chunks incrementally and achieves strong results on video spatial reasoning benchmarks.

Spatial-TTT 是一个框架，使用 test-time training（测试时训练，TTT）从流式视觉输入更新空间状态，使模型能够推理基于视频的空间任务。该方法增量处理视觉块，在视频空间推理基准测试中取得了优异成绩。

Tech Boss Uses AI and ChatGPT to Create Cancer Vaccine for His Dying Dog (3 minute read)

科技老板使用 AI 和 ChatGPT 为垂死的爱犬研制癌症疫苗（3 分钟阅读）

Sydney data engineer Paul Conyngham used ChatGPT, AlphaFold protein modeling, and a $3,000 genomic sequencing of his dog Rosie's tumor to produce a half-page mRNA formula that UNSW's RNA Institute turned into a physical vaccine in under two months. One tumor shrank 75% after her first injection in December 2025, marking the first personalized cancer vaccine ever designed for a dog. The pipeline mirrors Moderna and Merck's ongoing human trials. UNSW researchers are now asking why the same approach isn't being applied more broadly to cancer patients.

悉尼数据工程师 Paul Conyngham 使用 ChatGPT、AlphaFold 蛋白质建模，以及花费 3000 美元对其爱犬 Rosie 的肿瘤进行基因组测序，生成了一份半页的 mRNA（信使核糖核酸）配方，UNSW RNA 研究所在不到两个月内将其转化为实体疫苗。2025 年 12 月首次注射后，其中一个肿瘤缩小了 75%，这标志着首个为狗狗设计的个性化癌症疫苗诞生。该流程与 Moderna 和默克公司正在进行的人体试验相似。UNSW 研究人员现在正在质疑，为什么同样的方法没有被更广泛地应用于癌症患者。

Cerebras is coming to AWS (3 minute read)

Cerebras 即将登陆 AWS（3 分钟阅读）

AWS is deploying Cerebras CS-3 systems to offer the industry's fastest AI inference via AWS Bedrock, using open-source LLMs and Amazon's Nova models. The collaboration introduces a disaggregated architecture, pairing AWS Trainium for prefill with Cerebras WSE for decode, boosting token throughput by 5x. This setup enhances high-speed inference performance by efficiently utilizing specialized hardware for each computational phase.

AWS 正在部署 Cerebras CS-3 系统，通过 AWS Bedrock 提供业界最快的 AI 推理服务，使用开源大语言模型和亚马逊的 Nova 模型。此次合作引入了一种分离式架构，将用于预填充（prefill）的 AWS Trainium 与用于解码（decode）的 Cerebras WSE（晶圆级引擎）配对，将 token 吞吐量提升了 5 倍。该设置通过为每个计算阶段高效利用专用硬件，增强了高速推理性能。

Give your AI real-time web access (Sponsor)

赋予你的 AI 实时网络访问能力（赞助商）

claudetop (GitHub Repo)

claudetop（GitHub 仓库）

claudetop shows users where exactly their tokens and dollars go in real time.

claudetop 实时向用户展示他们的 token 和资金具体流向何处。

The Rise of Agent Computers (2 minute read)

智能体计算机的兴起（2 分钟阅读）

AMD is pitching a new device category called the "Agent Computer," always-on local hardware that runs AI agents continuously in the background while you sleep or work on other things, delegating tasks through Slack, WhatsApp, or iMessage.

AMD（超威半导体）正在推广一种名为"Agent Computer"（智能体计算机）的新设备类别，这是一种始终在线的本地硬件，在你睡觉或处理其他事务时持续在后台运行 AI 智能体，通过 Slack、WhatsApp 或 iMessage 委派任务。

LLM Architecture Gallery (Website)

大语言模型架构图库（网站）

This page features a collection of architecture figures and fact sheets from The Big LLM Architecture Comparison and A Dream of Spring for Open-Weight LLMs, focusing on the architecture panels only.

该页面收集了来自《大语言模型架构比较》和《开源权重大语言模型之春梦》的架构图和数据表，仅聚焦于架构面板部分。

ByteDance Delays Global Release of Seedance 2.0 (2 minute read)

字节跳动推迟 Seedance 2.0 全球发布（2 分钟阅读）

ByteDance paused the planned global rollout of its Seedance 2.0 AI video generator after viral clips triggered legal complaints from major Hollywood studios over alleged use of copyrighted characters and likenesses.

ByteDance（字节跳动）在其 Seedance 2.0 AI 视频生成器病毒式传播片段引发主要好莱坞工作室关于涉嫌使用受版权保护的角色和肖像的法律投诉后，暂停了原定的全球推广计划。

US Job Market Visualizer (Website)

美国就业市场可视化工具（网站）

This research tool visualizes 342 occupations, showing projected growth outlook, median pay, education requirements, and AI exposure.

该研究工具可视化了 342 种职业，展示预计增长前景、薪资中位数、教育要求以及 AI exposure（AI 替代风险/暴露度）。

Moonshot AI targets $1b raise, eyes $18b valuation (4 minute read)

月之暗面（Moonshot AI）目标融资 10 亿美元，估值瞄准 180 亿美元（4 分钟阅读）

Its rivals, Zhipu and MiniMax, recently traded at valuations between $30 billion and $40 billion in Hong Kong.

其竞争对手 Zhipu（智谱）和 MiniMax 近期在香港的估值交易区间在 300 亿至 400 亿美元之间。

原标题: From journalist to iOS developer: How LinkedIn’s editor builds with Claude Code | Daniel Roth

From journalist to iOS developer: How LinkedIn’s editor builds with Claude Code | Daniel Roth

从记者到 iOS 开发者：LinkedIn 主编如何用 Claude Code 构建应用 | Daniel Roth

Daniel Roth, editor in chief at LinkedIn, went from business writer to iOS app developer, without ever learning how to code. Using Claude Code, Daniel built and shipped multiple production-ready iOS apps to the App Store, including Commutely, a personalized train-tracking app for New York commuters.

Daniel Roth 是 LinkedIn 的总编辑，他从商业撰稿人转型为 iOS 应用开发者，期间从未学习过编程。借助 Claude Code，Daniel 开发并发布了多款生产级的 iOS 应用到 App Store，其中包括 Commutely——一款专为纽约通勤者打造的个性化火车追踪应用。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 什么是智能体工程
item.description:
标签: #智能体工程 #AI编程 #代码智能体

摘要: 本文阐述了"智能体工程"的概念，即利用能编写并执行代码的AI智能体（如Claude Code）辅助软件开发；与无审查的"vibe coding"不同，这种方式强调人类工程师应从直接编码转向定义问题、设计工具链和验证迭代，以产出更高质量的软件。

原标题: What is agentic engineering?

Agentic Engineering Patterns

I use the term agentic engineering to describe the practice of developing software with the assistance of coding agents.

我使用agentic engineering（代理工程）这个术语来描述在coding agents（编程代理）协助下开发软件的实践。

What are coding agents? They're agents that can both write and execute code. Popular examples include Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Gemini CLI.

什么是coding agents（编程代理）？它们是既能编写又能执行代码的代理。流行的例子包括Claude Code、OpenAI Codex和Gemini CLI。

What's an agent? Clearly defining that term is a challenge that has frustrated AI researchers since at least the 1990s but the definition I've come to accept, at least in the field of Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-5 and Gemini and Claude, is this one:

什么是agent（代理）？清晰定义这个术语是一项挑战，自1990年代以来就一直困扰着人工智能研究者，但我已接受的定义是——至少在LLMs（Large Language Models，大语言模型）领域，如 GPT-5、Gemini 和 Claude——如下：

The "agent" is software that calls an LLM with your prompt and passes it a set of tool definitions, then calls any tools that the LLM requests and feeds the results back into the LLM.

"Agent（代理）"是一种软件，它用你的提示词（prompt）调用LLM（大语言模型），并传递一组工具定义给模型，然后调用 LLM 请求的任何工具，并将结果反馈回 LLM。

For coding agents, those tools include one that can execute code.

对于coding agents（编程代理），这些工具包含能够执行代码的工具。

You prompt the coding agent to define a goal. The agent then generates and executes code in a loop until that goal has been met.

你提示编程代理定义一个目标。然后该代理在循环中生成并执行代码，直到达成该目标。

Code execution is the defining capability that makes agentic engineering possible. Without the ability to directly run the code, anything output by an LLM is of limited value. With code execution, these agents can start iterating towards software that demonstrably works.

代码执行是使agentic engineering（代理工程）成为可能的决定性能力。没有直接运行代码的能力，LLM 输出的任何内容价值都有限。有了代码执行能力，这些代理就能开始迭代，朝着确实可用的软件迈进。

Agentic engineering

Now that we have software that can write working code, what is there left for us humans to do?

现在我们有了能够编写可用代码的软件，我们人类还有什么可做的呢？

The answer is so much stuff.

答案是还有很多事情要做。

Writing code has never been the sole activity of a software engineer. The craft has always been figuring out what code to write. Any given software problem has dozens of potential solutions, each with their own tradeoffs. Our job is to navigate those options and find the ones that are the best fit for our unique set of circumstances and requirements.

编写代码从来不是软件工程师的唯一活动。这门手艺始终是在弄清楚该写什么代码。任何给定的软件问题都有数十种潜在的解决方案，每种都有其自身的权衡取舍。我们的工作是在这些选项中导航，找到最适合我们独特情况和需求的方案。

Getting great results out of coding agents is a deep subject in its own right, especially now as the field continues to evolve at a bewildering rate.

从coding agents（编程代理）获得出色结果本身就是一个深奥的课题，尤其是现在该领域正以令人眩晕的速度持续发展。

We need to provide our coding agents with the tools they need to solve our problems, specify those problems in the right level of detail, and verify and iterate on the results until we are confident they address our problems in a robust and credible way.

我们需要为编程代理提供解决问题所需的工具，以适当的详细程度明确这些问题，并验证和迭代结果，直到我们确信它们以稳健且可信的方式解决了我们的问题。

LLMs don't learn from their past mistakes, but coding agents can, provided we deliberately update our instructions and tool harnesses to account for what we learn along the way.

LLMs（大语言模型）不会从过去的错误中学习，但coding agents（编程代理）可以——前提是我们有意识地更新指令和工具套件，以考虑我们沿途学到的经验。

Used effectively, coding agents can help us be much more ambitious with the projects we take on. Agentic engineering should help us produce more, better quality code that solves more impactful problems.

如果有效使用，编程代理可以帮助我们在承担的项目上变得更加雄心勃勃。Agentic engineering（代理工程）应该帮助我们产出更多、更高质量的代码，解决更有影响力的问题。

Isn't this just vibe coding?

The term "vibe coding" was coined by Andrej Karpathy in February 2025 - coincidentally just three weeks prior to the original release of Claude Code - to describe prompting LLMs to write code while you "forget that the code even exists".

"vibe coding"这一术语由Andrej Karpathy于2025年2月创造——巧合的是，就在Claude Code最初发布的三周前——用来描述在提示 LLM 编写代码时"忘记代码甚至存在"的状态。

Some people extend that definition to cover any time an LLM is used to produce code at all, but I think that's a mistake. Vibe coding is more useful in its original definition - we need a term to describe unreviewed, prototype-quality LLM-generated code that distinguishes it from code that the author has brought up to a production ready standard.

有些人扩展了这一定义，涵盖任何使用 LLM 生成代码的情况，但我认为这是一个错误。Vibe coding在其原始定义中更有用——我们需要一个术语来描述未经审查的、原型质量的 LLM 生成代码，以将其与作者提升到生产就绪标准（production ready）的代码区分开来。

About this guide

Just like the field it attempts to cover, Agentic Engineering Patterns is very much a work in progress. My goal is to identify and describe patterns for working with these tools that demonstrably get results, and that are unlikely to become outdated as the tools advance.

就像它试图涵盖的领域一样，《Agentic Engineering Patterns》（代理工程模式）目前仍在进行中。我的目标是识别和描述使用这些工具的模式，这些模式能够明确地取得成果，并且不太可能随着工具的进步而过时。

I'll continue adding more chapters as new techniques emerge. No chapter should be considered finished. I'll be updating existing chapters as our understanding of these patterns evolves.

随着新技术出现，我将继续添加更多章节。任何章节都不应被视为已完成。随着我们对这些模式的理解不断发展，我将更新现有章节。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 编程智能体的工作原理
item.description:
标签: #编程智能体 #LLM #工具调用

摘要: 编码智能体通过系统提示和工具调用扩展大语言模型的能力，其核心是LLM与工具在循环中持续交互，使AI能够自主执行代码编写、调试等复杂任务。

原标题: How coding agents work

Agentic Engineering Patterns

As with any tool, understanding howcoding agentswork under the hood can help you make better decisions about how to apply them.

与任何工具一样，理解 coding agents（编程智能体）的底层工作原理有助于你更好地决定如何应用它们。

A coding agent is a piece of software that acts as aharnessfor an LLM, extending that LLM with additional capabilities that are powered by invisible prompts and implemented as callable tools.

Coding agent（编程智能体）是一种充当 LLM（Large Language Model，大语言模型）harness（承载框架）的软件，通过不可见的提示词（prompts）为 LLM 扩展额外能力，并以可调用工具（callable tools）的形式实现这些能力。

Large Language Models

At the heart of any coding agent is a Large Language Model, or LLM. These have names like GPT-5.4 or Claude Opus 4.6 or Gemini 3.1 Pro or Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.

任何编程智能体的核心都是 Large Language Model（大语言模型，简称 LLM）。这些模型有着诸如 GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro 或 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 等名称。

An LLM is a machine learning model that can complete a sentence of text. Give the model the phrase "the cat sat on the " and it will (almost certainly) suggest "mat" as the next word in the sentence.

LLM 是一种能够补全文本句子的机器学习模型。给模型输入短语 "the cat sat on the "，它（几乎肯定）会建议将 "mat" 作为句子的下一个词。

As these models get larger and train on increasing amounts of data, they can complete more complex sentences - like "a python function to download a file from a URL is def download_file(url): ".

随着这些模型规模越来越大，并在越来越多的数据上进行训练，它们能够补全更复杂的句子——例如 "a python function to download a file from a URL is def download_file(url): "。

LLMs don't actually work directly with words - they work with tokens. A sequence of text is converted into a sequence of integer tokens, so "the cat sat on the " becomes[3086, 9059, 10139, 402, 290, 220]. This is worth understanding because LLM providers charge based on the number of tokens processed, and are limited in how many tokens they can consider at a time.

LLM 实际上并不直接处理单词——它们处理的是 tokens（词元）。一段文本序列会被转换成整数词元序列，因此 "the cat sat on the " 会变成 [3086, 9059, 10139, 402, 290, 220]。理解这一点很重要，因为 LLM 提供商根据处理的词元数量收费，并且模型一次能处理的词元数量也有限制。

You can experiment with the OpenAI tokenizer to see how this works atplatform.openai.com/tokenizer.

你可以在 OpenAI 的分词器（tokenizer）上实验这一机制，网址是 platform.openai.com/tokenizer。

The input to an LLM is called theprompt. The text returned by an LLM is called thecompletion, or sometimes theresponse.

输入给 LLM 的内容称为 prompt（提示词）。LLM 返回的文本称为 completion（补全），有时也称为 response（响应）。

Many models today aremultimodal, which means they can accept more than just text as input.Vision LLMs(vLLMs) can accept images as part of the input, which means you can feed them sketches or photos or screenshots. A common misconception is that these are run through a separate process for OCR or image analysis, but these inputs are actually turned into yet more token integers which are processed in the same way as text.

如今许多模型都是 multimodal（多模态）的，这意味着它们不仅能接受文本作为输入。Vision LLMs（视觉大语言模型，简称 vLLMs）可以将图像作为输入的一部分，这意味着你可以向它们提供草图、照片或截图。一个常见的误解是这些图像会通过单独的 OCR 或图像分析流程处理，但实际上这些输入会被转换成更多的整数词元，并以与文本相同的方式处理。

Chat templated prompts

The first LLMs worked as completion engines - users were expected to provide a prompt which could then be completed by the model, such as the two examples shown above.

最初的 LLM 充当补全引擎（completion engines）工作——用户需要提供一个提示词，然后由模型来补全，就像上面展示的两个例子那样。

This wasn't particularly user-friendly so models mostly switched to usingchat templated promptsinstead, which represent communication with the model as a simulated conversation.

这种方式对用户并不特别友好，因此模型大多转而使用 chat templated prompts（聊天模板提示词），将模型交互模拟成一场对话。

This is actually just a form of completion prompt with a special format that looks something like this. 
user: write a python function to download a file from a URL
assistant:

这其实只是补全提示词的一种特殊格式，看起来大致如下。

The natural completion for this prompt is for the assistant (represented by the LLM) to answer the user's question with some Python code.

对于这个提示词，自然的补全方式是助手（由 LLM 代表）用一段 Python 代码回答用户的问题。

LLMs are stateless: every time they execute a prompt they start from the same blank slate.

LLM 是无状态的（stateless）：每次执行提示词时，它们都从相同的空白状态开始。

To maintain the simulation of a conversation, the software that talks to the model needs to maintain its own state and replay the entire existing conversation every time the user enters a new chat prompt: 
user: write a python function to download a file from a URL
assistant: def download_url(url):
    return urllib.request.urlopen(url).read()
user: use the requests library instead
assistant:

为了维持对话的模拟效果，与模型交互的软件需要自己维护状态，并在用户每次输入新的聊天提示词时，重新播放整个已有的对话记录：

Since providers charge for both input and output tokens, this means that as a conversation gets longer, each prompt becomes more expensive since the number of input tokens grows every time.

由于提供商对输入和输出的词元都收费，这意味着随着对话变长，每次提示词都会变得更昂贵，因为输入词元的数量每次都在增加。

Token caching

Most model providers offset this somewhat through a cheaper rate forcached input tokens- common token prefixes that have been processed within a short time period can be charged at a lower rate as the underlying infrastructure can cache and then reuse many of the expensive calculations used to process that input.

大多数模型提供商通过为 cached input tokens（缓存输入词元）提供更低的费率来在一定程度上抵消这一成本——在短时间内已处理的常见词元前缀可以按更低费率计费，因为底层基础设施可以缓存并重复使用许多用于处理该输入的昂贵计算。

Coding agents are designed with this optimization in mind - they avoid modifying earlier conversation content to ensure the cache is used as efficiently as possible.

Coding agents（编程智能体）在设计时就考虑到了这一优化——它们避免修改早期的对话内容，以确保缓存能够被尽可能高效地利用。

Calling tools

The defining feature of an LLMagentis that agents can calltools. But what is a tool?

LLM agent（LLM 智能体）的决定性特征是智能体能够调用 tools（工具）。但什么是工具呢？

A tool is a function that the agent harness makes available to the LLM.

工具是智能体承载框架（agent harness）向 LLM 提供的一个函数。

At the level of the prompt itself, that looks something like this: 
system: If you need to access the weather, end your turn with get_weather(city_name)
user: what's the weather in San Francisco?
assistant:

在提示词层面，它看起来大致如下：

Here the assistant might respond with the following text: 
get_weather("San Francisco")

在这种情况下，助手可能会用以下文本回应：

The model harness software then extracts that function call request from the response - probably with a regular expression - and executes the tool.

随后，模型承载框架软件会从响应中提取该函数调用请求——可能是通过正则表达式——并执行该工具。

It then returns the result to the model, with a constructed prompt that looks something like this: 
system: If you need to access the weather, end your turn with get_weather(city_name)
user: what's the weather in San Francisco?
assistant: get_weather("San Francisco")
user: 61°, Partly cloudy
assistant:

然后它将结果返回给模型，并构造一个看起来大致如下的提示词：

The LLM can now use that tool result to help generate an answer to the user's question.

LLM 现在可以利用该工具结果来帮助生成对用户问题的回答。

Most coding agents define a dozen or more tools for the agent to call. The most powerful of these allow for code execution - aBash()tool for executing terminal commands, or aPython()tool for running Python code, for example.

大多数编程智能体定义了十几个或更多的工具供智能体调用。其中最强大的工具允许代码执行——例如一个用于执行终端命令的 Bash() 工具，或一个用于运行 Python 代码的 Python() 工具。

The system prompt

In the previous example I included an initial message marked "system" which informed the LLM about the available tool and how to call it.

在上面的例子中，我包含了一条标记为 "system" 的初始消息，它告知 LLM 有哪些可用工具以及如何调用它们。

Coding agents usually start every conversation with a system prompt like this, which is not shown to the user but provides instructions telling the model how it should behave.

编程智能体通常在每次对话开始时都使用这样的 system prompt（系统提示词），这不会展示给用户，但会向模型提供指令，告诉它应该如何表现。

These system prompts can be hundreds of lines long. Here'sthe system prompt for OpenAI Codexas-of March 2026, which is a useful clear example of the kind of instructions that make these coding agents work.

这些系统提示词可能长达数百行。这是截至 2026 年 3 月 OpenAI Codex 的系统提示词，它是让这类编程智能体运作的指令类型的一个有用且清晰的示例。

Reasoning

One of the big new advances in 2025 was the introduction ofreasoningto the frontier model families.

2025 年的重大进展之一是将 reasoning（推理能力）引入前沿模型家族。

Reasoning, sometimes presented asthinkingin the UI, is when a model spends additional time generating text that talks through the problem and its potential solutions before presenting a reply to the user.

Reasoning（推理）有时在界面上呈现为 thinking（思考），是指模型在向用户呈现回复之前，花费额外时间生成文本来梳理问题及其潜在解决方案的过程。

This can look similar to a person thinking out loud, and has a similar effect. Crucially it allows models to spend more time (and more tokens) working on a problem in order to hopefully get a better result.

这可能看起来类似于一个人在大声思考，并且具有类似的效果。关键的是，它允许模型花费更多时间（和更多词元）来处理问题，以期获得更好的结果。

Reasoning is particularly useful for debugging issues in code as it gives the model an opportunity to navigate more complex code paths, mixing in tool calls and using the reasoning phase to follow function calls back to the potential source of an issue.

Reasoning（推理）对于调试代码问题特别有用，因为它给了模型机会去遍历更复杂的代码路径，混合使用工具调用，并利用推理阶段追溯函数调用回到问题的潜在根源。

Many coding agents include options for dialing up or down the reasoning effort level, encouraging models to spend more time chewing on harder problems.

许多编程智能体包含调节推理努力程度的选项，鼓励模型在更难的问题上花费更多时间深入思考。

LLM + system prompt + tools in a loop

Believe it or not, that's most of what it takes to build a coding agent!

信不信由你，构建一个编程智能体所需的要素大致就是这些！

If you want to develop a deeper understanding of how these things work, a useful exercise is to try building your own agent from scratch. A simple tool loop can be achieved with a few dozen lines of code on top of an existing LLM API.

如果你想深入理解这些事物的工作原理，一个有用的练习是尝试从头构建你自己的智能体。一个简单的工具循环（tool loop）只需在现有 LLM API 的基础上用几十行代码就能实现。

Agoodtool loop is a great deal more work than that, but the fundamental mechanics are surprisingly straightforward.

一个优秀的工具循环（good tool loop）需要比这多得多的工作，但基本机制却出奇地简单。

item.description:
标签: #AI编程 #数据分析 #数据新闻

摘要: 本文介绍了一场使用Claude Code与OpenAI Codex等AI编程智能体进行数据分析的工作坊，展示了如何通过自然语言交互完成数据库查询、数据清洗及交互式可视化（如基于Leaflet的树木分布热力图），为数据记者等从业者提供了实用的AI辅助数据探索方案。

原标题: Coding agents for data analysis

Coding agents for data analysis

Coding agents for data analysis

数据分析的编码智能体（Coding agents）

Here's the table of contents:

以下是目录：

Coding agents
Warmup: ChatGPT and Claude
Setup Claude Code and Codex
Asking questions against a database
Exploring data with agents
Cleaning data: decoding neighborhood codes
Creating visualizations with agents

I ran the workshop using GitHub Codespaces and OpenAI Codex, since it was easy (and inexpensive) to distribute a budget-restricted API key for Codex that attendees could use during the class. Participants ended up burning $23 of Codex tokens.

我使用 GitHub Codespaces 和 OpenAI Codex 运行了这次工作坊，因为分发受预算限制的 Codex API 密钥（API key）供参与者在课堂上使用既方便又便宜。参与者最终消耗了价值 23 美元的 Codex token。

The exercises all used Python and SQLite and some of them used Datasette.

所有练习都使用了 Python 和 SQLite，其中一些还使用了 Datasette。

One highlight of the workshop was when we started running Datasette such that it served static content from a viz/ folder, then had Claude Code start vibe coding new interactive visualizations directly in that folder. Here's a heat map it created for my trees database using Leaflet and Leaflet.heat, source code here.

工作坊的一个亮点是，当我们启动 Datasette 使其从 viz/ 文件夹提供静态内容，然后让 Claude Code 开始在该文件夹中进行 氛围编码（vibe coding，指借助 AI 进行直觉式编程）创建新的交互式可视化。以下是为我的树木数据库创建的热力图，使用了 Leaflet 和 Leaflet.heat，源代码在此。

I designed the handout to also be useful for people who weren't able to attend the session in person. As is usually the case, material aimed at data journalists is equally applicable to anyone else with data to explore.

我设计这份讲义时也考虑到了无法亲自到场参加的人员。通常情况下，面向数据新闻记者（data journalists）的材料同样适用于任何有其他数据需要探索的人。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: MacBook Neo摄像头指示灯的安全机制
item.description:
标签: #MacBook #隐私安全 #硬件安全

摘要: MacBook Neo的软件摄像头指示灯运行在芯片安全隔离区（secure exclave）中，安全性堪比硬件指示灯，即使遭遇内核级漏洞攻击也无法绕过该指示灯秘密启用摄像头。

原标题: Quoting Guilherme Rambo

Tidbit: the software-based camera indicator light in the MacBook Neo runs in the secure exclave1 part of the chip, so it is almost as secure as the hardware indicator light. What that means in practice is that even a kernel-level exploit would not be able to turn on the camera without the light appearing on screen. It runs in a privileged environment separate from the kernel and blits the light directly onto the screen hardware.

小知识：MacBook Neo 的软件相机指示灯运行在芯片的 secure exclave（安全隔离区）1 部分，因此其安全性几乎与硬件指示灯相当。这在实际中意味着，即使是内核级漏洞（kernel-level exploit）也无法在指示灯不亮的情况下启动摄像头。它运行在与内核隔离的特权环境（privileged environment）中，并直接将指示灯图像位块传输（blit）到屏幕硬件上。

—Guilherme Rambo, in a text message to John Gruber

——Guilherme Rambo，在给 John Gruber 的短信中

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Anthropic对齐团队成员：勒索实验的意义
item.description:
标签: #AI对齐 #AI安全 #政策沟通

摘要: Anthropic对齐科学团队成员表示，设计该"勒索练习"的目的是为政策制定者提供直观且具冲击力的实证，使此前从未关注过AI对齐问题的人切实感知到模型不对齐的风险。

原标题: Quoting A member of Anthropic’s alignment-science team

Quoting A member of Anthropic’s alignment-science team

The point of the blackmail exercise was to have something to describe to policymakers—results that are visceral enough to land with people, and make misalignment risk actually salient in practice for people who had never thought about it before.

开展blackmail exercise（勒索演练）的目的在于向政策制定者提供可描述的具体素材——那些足以让人们切实感受到、并使misalignment risk（未对齐风险）对从未思考过这一问题的人而言实际上变得显著可见的结果。

—A member of Anthropic's alignment-science team, as told to Gideon Lewis-Kraus

——Anthropic（人工智能安全公司）alignment-science（对齐科学）团队成员，向 Gideon Lewis-Kraus（记者）所述
